import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-native-rig-matrix-free-v1")
def images(model):
    result={}
    with (model/"images.txt").open() as stream:
        for line in stream:
            if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"): continue
            row=line.split()
            assert len(row)==10
            key=int(row[0]); assert key not in result
            fields=next(stream).split(); assert len(fields)%3==0
            result[key]=(row[8:],tuple((fields[i],fields[i+1]) for i in range(0,len(fields),3)),tuple(int(fields[i+2]) for i in range(0,len(fields),3)))
    return result
reference=root/"candidate-legacy/model"
a=images(reference)
reports={}
for arm in ("matrix-free-a","matrix-free-b"):
    model=root/arm/"model"; b=images(model)
    assert a.keys()==b.keys()
    assert (reference/"cameras.txt").read_bytes()==(model/"cameras.txt").read_bytes()
    changed=0
    for key in a:
        assert a[key][:2]==b[key][:2],key
        changed+=sum(x!=y for x,y in zip(a[key][2],b[key][2]))
    reports[arm]={"image_identity_and_ordered_xy_exact":True,"camera_bytes_exact":True,"keypoints":sum(len(v[1]) for v in b.values()),"changed_point_id_assignments":changed,"model_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256((model/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ("cameras.txt","images.txt","points3D.txt")}}
assert reports["matrix-free-a"]["model_sha256"]==reports["matrix-free-b"]["model_sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"arms":reports,"repeat_model_bytes_exact":True,"note":"Point IDs may be renumbered; changed assignments are not a semantic track-overlap score. Native final anchor equality is not asserted."},indent=2))
